benchmarks.name: APEX-Accounting
benchmarks.summary: Long-horizon month-end close tasks (reconciliations, accruals, postings, reports) executed by agents across accounting software, spreadsheets, PDFs and mail.

metric_definitions.mean-score: Average share of each task's rubric criteria the model met, as judged by the publisher's LLM grader.
metric_definitions.pass-1: Share of tasks where the model met every rubric criterion on a single attempt.

benchmarks.size: 160 private tasks in 10 worlds, 2,186 criteria; public dev set of 10 tasks / 89 criteria
benchmarks.relevance_note: Closest public analogue to Calibration Arena's close work; dev-set scores are explicitly not comparable to the leaderboard.

results.note: Best Pass^8 is 2.6% (GPT-5.6-Sol); best Pass@8 is 21.5% (paper abstract). $/run comes from the publisher's cost study (7 models); cost-study rows whose score differs from the current leaderboard are left without cost.

benchmarks.notes: Leaderboard judge is DeepSeek-v4-Flash with an unreleased GEPA-optimized template; the open Harbor/Archipelago grader defaults to a different judge.

benchmarks.name: CloseBench (PyPI)
benchmarks.summary: Deterministic seeded double-entry ledgers with planted month-end closing errors for agents to find and fix.
benchmarks.relevance_note: Runnable close benchmark with a programmatic grader, but nobody has published model results yet.
benchmarks.notes: Unrelated to Calibration Arena's internal CloseBench-mini.

benchmarks.name: DualEntry Accounting AI Benchmark
benchmarks.summary: Task-oriented accounting questions against a provisioned chart of accounts: classification, journal entries, AP, AR, bank reconciliation, reporting, month-end close and knowledge.

metric_definitions.accuracy: Share of the 101 questions answered correctly, graded pass/fail by deterministic checks.

benchmarks.relevance_note: Broad model coverage on accounting tasks, but questions and grader are unpublished, so scores cannot be reproduced.

results.note: Page JSON-LD date (2026-02-20) predates listed models; no explicit as-of date for scores. as_of is our fetch date.

benchmarks.notes: Grading described by the page as deterministic and binary; not released.

benchmarks.name: FinBalance
benchmarks.summary: Multi-document reconciliation: turn OCR'd source documents into balanced journal entries and a final balance sheet, or flag the packet as inconsistent.
benchmarks.size: 710 main + 143 coverage records (480 standard, 230 negative controls in main)
benchmarks.relevance_note: Deterministic, plain-text and runnable today; a strong candidate for Calibration Arena reproductions.

results.note: Paper baseline table over 480 standard records.
